question: What breadth proportion relative to length is considered beautiful?
premises: Breadth is measured by half the length.
An alternative adds one part to that measure.
The resulting proportion is described as beautiful.
inference: A breadth of half the length, or one part more, is considered beautiful.
uncertainties: The exact size of the added part is context-dependent.
plain_english: In breadth, half the length is beautiful, or that increased by one part.
